title: Slidepilot | Agentic TikTok Generator for Apps
excerpt: Create TikTok slideshows for your app with coding agents like Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, or Cursor through MCP. Apply for the paid private beta.
content_html:
For app founders who’d rather build than market

Let Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, or Cursor make TikTok slideshows for your app.

Product demo

YouTube video coming soon

Want posts like these for your app?

SlidePilot is a paid private beta for a small group of app founders. Tell us about your app and we’ll email you if there’s a spot.

Questions about SlidePilot

What is SlidePilot?

SlidePilot is a TikTok slideshow generator for app founders that connects to coding agents such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, or Cursor through MCP. Your coding agent writes the post; SlidePilot finds photos and renders the slides. You review, download, and post them to TikTok.

How do I create a TikTok slideshow for my app?

Connect SlidePilot to your coding agent through MCP and sign in with your approved Google account. Share your app link and audience with your agent. It writes the post, and SlidePilot finds photos and renders the slides. Review and download the finished images, then post them to TikTok.

Can I remake a TikTok slideshow or edit the result?

Yes. Share a link to a TikTok photo slideshow, and your coding agent can adapt its structure and pacing for your app. Ask it to shorten the hook, swap a photo, rewrite a slide, or add an app screenshot. SlidePilot redraws the post for you to review.

How do I get access?

Apply with the form on this page. SlidePilot is a paid private beta while we work closely with a small group of founders. If there’s a spot, we’ll email you with pricing and setup.

What do I get from each post?

Six finished slides at TikTok’s full 1080 × 1920 size, plus a caption and hashtags. A remake has as many slides as the post it copies, plus one for your app if it needs it.

Which coding agents can I use?

Use a coding agent such as Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity, or Cursor with support for remote MCP servers and browser sign-in. Connect SlidePilot as an MCP server and sign in with your approved Google account. Setup depends on your agent.

Who writes the slides?

Your coding agent does, following SlidePilot’s guide to hooks and formats. SlidePilot finds the photos and draws the slides. Want a different hook? Ask your agent for one.

Does it post to TikTok for me?

No. You stay in control: save the slides, add a sound, and post when you’re ready.

Does it only work with iPhone apps?

An App Store link lets SlidePilot show your app’s real screenshot. For a web app or another product, give your coding agent a link to a screenshot instead.
